source: Kettle et al. 2022, BMJ 376:e068465, web appendix ketv068465.ww.pdf, 'Search strategy (Sept 2020)', MEDLINE and MEDLINE In-Process (Ovid) lines 1-46 only
methods_text: Search devised and tested in Medline, combining intervention and setting terms with established RCT filters; adapted for Embase, PsycINFO, CINAHL, SPORTDiscus, Sports Medicine and Education Index, ASSIA, PEDro, Bibliomap, SCI-E, CPCI-S, OpenGrey; trial registers CENTRAL, ClinicalTrials.gov, TRoPHI. No date limits except SCI-E (past 10 years). Searches 9-21 September 2020; brief PubMed update covering the six months after, before final analyses (1 April 2021). No restriction on publication type, year or language.
